visual_events.label: High-angle pan right and hold across brick-on-edge wall corners, T-junction and hollow cavities
visual_events.description: From 0.0s to about 2.2s, the camera holds in a high-angle close view looking down at the left L-corner and a central T-junction of a low, multi-course red-brick wall built on sandy ground, showing bricks laid on edge with rectangular hollow vertical cavities between parallel stretchers and cross-headers, and wet grey mortar dabbed along the top edges and capped over the T-junction. From about 2.2s to 7.8s, the camera pans smoothly to the right along the top of the wall past the mortar-capped T-junction, revealing a metal mortar pan containing a red-handled trowel on the ground beyond the wall at about 3.2s, and continuing to a right-hand L-corner with exposed hollow cavities. From about 7.8s to 11.050667s, the camera settles and holds on the right section of the wall, showing the T-junction at the left edge, two rectangular hollow cavities along the top course in the middle, the right L-corner, and the mortar pan and trowel on the ground above.
visual_events.context_result: Clearly reveals the three-dimensional geometry of bricks laid on edge, the continuous hollow cavities inside the wall, and the bonding layout at two corners and an intersecting partition T-junction.
visual_events.camera_framing: High-angle medium close-up, panning right from ~2.2s to ~7.8s and holding steady at the start (0.0s–2.2s) and end (7.8s–11.050667s).
visual_events.uncertainty: No active bricklaying occurs in this clip; the mortar is fresh/wet, indicating recently completed courses.

script: P001 states 'Unlike conventional brickwork, where bricks are laid flat, Rat-Trap Bond Masonry places bricks on their edge. This arrangement creates continuous hollow cavities within the wall.'

background_knowledge: Rat-Trap Bond is defined in masonry practice as a double-wythe-equivalent bond of bricks laid on edge in a modular shiner-and-rowlock (stretcher-and-header on edge) pattern leaving internal vertical cavities.

claim_evidence.limits: The clip shows only a low, partially built demonstration wall on bare soil without active laying of each course or a full-height wall.
